authority: PTO ASL, catalogs, requirements, and accepted ADRs remain normative. The independent executable model is corroborating evidence only.

closure_judgment.basis: The exhaustive row-disposition obligation S5-T3-G1 is complete: every PTO scalar form, command form, and direct tile operation has a stable classification and PTO-owned evidence. S5-T3 closes only when the clean independent snapshot passes every archived parser, executable-backend, generated-status, coverage, and documentation gate.

model_limits.disposition: The immutable independent snapshot predates the accepted command-encoding, compact TEPL-selector ABI, and completed TLOAD/TSTORE operand schema. The retained matrix preserves 8 command encoding divergences and 62 active direct-tile ABI divergences instead of relabeling them as exact matches.

PTO models Reg5 selectors 24..31 as T/U queue reads and only selectors 30/31 as queue-push destinations; the independent executable subset is a flat-form comparison and does not by itself validate queue payload ordering.

The independent model corroborates one 64-bit MPAR/MSEQ execution mask. PTO separately defines eight 32-bit warp predicates with hardwired P0; the comparison does not establish their selector or execution contract.

PTO-v0 bundle commit resolves the complete direct-operation schema from ordered B.IOT/B.IOR bindings, bundle headers, and operation defaults. All 107 direct tile operations are schema-representable; malformed or surplus bindings still reject before tile effects.
PTO defines 85 TEPL operations. The retained independent selector evidence is classified row by row; TFMA is an explicit PTO-owned extension.
The retained TLSU and CUBE manifest rows are header/function evidence rather than independent tile payload execution; GMOV is an explicit PTO-owned extension.
Tile payload effects, aliases, legality, packed four-bit memory behavior, and raw numeric carriers are closed by PTO-owned ASL tests and ADRs, not by the independent executable model.
